verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own programmatic surfaces for headless automation: an API-key-authenticated REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, a Status Page API, and a Terraform provider for infrastructure-as-code. These let the product be driven without the UI, but nothing documents a CLI, a CI integration (such as a CI action or pipeline guide), or a hands-on report of running it in CI. Missing for 10: official CLI, documented CI/pipeline usage, independent corroboration of headless/CI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The API is hosted at `https://api.incident.io/`, and you will need an API key from your incident.io dashboard to make requests.
It documents available API endpoints, provides examples of how to use them, and covers authentication, rate limits, and error handling.
We're working through our Terraform provider resource by resource to make your infra-as-code setup easier to understand and maintain.
the Status Page API for programmatically managing incidents and maintenance windows
